device_code_copy.title: Copy the login code
device_code_copy.description:
1. Copy the one-time code below.
2. Select Next.
3. On the next screen, open the ChatGPT login link and paste the code.

device_code_retry.title: Sign in with ChatGPT
device_code_retry.description: The previous device login could not be completed. Submit to generate a new device code and try again.

progress.wait_for_device:
Now open this URL and sign in with ChatGPT:
{verification_url}

Paste the code you copied in the previous step and complete the login.

Home Assistant will continue automatically after Codex confirms the login. The code expires after 15 minutes.

error.access_token_required: Access token is required for this auth method.
error.device_code_expired: The device code expired before login completed. Generate a new code and try again.
error.device_code_cancelled: The device login task was cancelled. Generate a new code and try again.
error.token_exchange_failed: Authorization completed, but token exchange failed.
